meta.title: Law and order
meta.question: Should the state be tough on crime, or protect civil liberties?
meta.measure: Average position on crime and punishment, from 0 (civil liberties) to 10 (tough on crime)
meta.anchor: Pooled from questions on the death penalty, on fighting crime at the cost of civil liberties and on harsher sentences, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Are you for abolishing or for keeping the death penalty?
items.notes: CBOS.

items.wording: Do courts deal with criminals too harshly, about right, or not harshly enough?
items.notes: PGSS; 'about right' placed in the middle.

items.wording: For or against the death penalty for murder
items.notes: PGSS.

items.wording: Crime, as above, 1-9
